parameters.name: AddInstanceList
parameters.description: The list of instances to add in this update. You do not need to specify this parameter if no instances need to be added.

sub_parameters.name: InstanceId
sub_parameters.description: The instance ID of the instance to associate.

sub_parameters.name: InstanceType
sub_parameters.description: The type of the instance to associate. Valid values: **PHYSICALCONNECTION**: Express Connect circuit.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each API request.

parameters.name: QosDescription
parameters.description:
The description of the QoS policy.

The description must be 0 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: QosId
parameters.description: The ID of the QoS policy.

parameters.name: QosName
parameters.description:
The name of the QoS policy.

The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the QoS policy.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

parameters.name: RemoveInstanceList
parameters.description: The list of instances to remove in this update. You do not need to specify this parameter if no instances need to be removed.

sub_parameters.name: InstanceId
sub_parameters.description: The instance ID of the associated instance.

sub_parameters.name: InstanceType
sub_parameters.description: The type of the associated instance. Valid values: **PHYSICALCONNECTION**: Express Connect circuit.
